title: Model creature armorClass sources and conditional AC variants
description:
Scope:
- Preserve all AC parentheticals and conditional AC values from SRD creature statlines.
- Fable quantified 206 AC parentheticals.
- Examples: natural armor, leather armor + shield, Mage "15 with mage armor", Druid "16 with barkskin", Ankheg "11 while prone", lycanthrope beast/hybrid AC.

Acceptance criteria:
- Creature armorClass supports value plus source/sourceText and optional variants/conditions.
- All 206 AC parentheticals identified by Fable are represented, or any non-mechanical exception is documented with a test/allowlist.
- Conditional AC is queryable by deterministic tools.
- Tests cover armor, natural armor, spell-adjusted AC, prone/conditional AC, and lycanthrope form AC.
close_reason: Implemented in PR #394: armorClass modeled as {value, source?, condition?, variants?, sourceText}; all printed parentheticals preserved (202 base sources + 8 variant-bearing records: Mage/Archmage, Druid/Dryad, Ankheg, 3 dual-form lycanthropes); fail-closed anchored grammar; queryable variants; tests for armor, natural armor, spell-adjusted, prone, and lycanthrope form AC.
